scope: Minimum MIT-licensed upstream CUDA MMQ/dequant reference set relevant to 2-bit and 4-bit operations for the SM86 Q2_B64/Q4_B64 correctness baseline. Files are byte-identical to the pinned revision; verify with the SHA-256 values below before trusting any anchor.

files.purpose: Ground-truth upstream packed block layouts (block_q2_K lines 288-299, block_q4_K lines 317-328, QK_K super-block constants lines 87-151) that the MMQ tile loaders consume. Vendored because mmq.cuh dereferences these structs.
Device dequantization patterns: half-scale fetch plus nibble/bit extraction (dequantize_q4_0 lines 25-38). Reference for the Q2_B64/Q4_B64 dequant stage of the fused matvec.

dp4a-based quantized dot products: integer unpack helpers (get_int_b1/b2/b4 lines 7-32) and vec_dot_q4_0_q8_1_impl (lines 115-137) plus Q2_K/Q4_K impls used by the MMQ dp4a fallback. Reference for the 2-bit/4-bit integer accumulation stage.
mma.sync and ldmatrix wrappers gated on Ampere (lines 923-1022, 1162-1224). Required include of mmq.cuh; ground truth for the SM86 mma tile path.

MMQ shared-memory tile layouts and kernels: dp4a tile sizes for Q2_K/Q4_K (lines 186-229), load_tiles_q2_K (lines 1628-1685), load_tiles_q4_K (line 2093), mul_mat_q kernel entry (line 3542) and launch logic (lines 3955-4090). Reference for tile sizing and launch geometry of the future fused kernels.

Host-side MMQ dispatch: stream-k selection for Volta+ (lines 121-122, 252-260) and per-architecture MMQ eligibility in ggml_cuda_should_use_mmq (lines 267-378). Reference for SM86 profile gating in the Rust ABI descriptor.

Qwen-compatible fused recurrent update, register-resident state shards, warp reduction, decode/prefill traversal, and rollback-slot organization. Reference for CTOX's FP16-state SM86 GatedDeltaNet candidate; the upstream state is FP32 and must not be represented as satisfying the Fold memory profile.
Unmodified public host/cache declaration paired with gated_delta_net.cu.
RMSNorm block reduction and fused multiply/add organization. Reference for Qwen (1+weight) and direct-weight gated RMSNorm candidates.
Unmodified public host declaration paired with norm.cu.
Depthwise state-space causal convolution with fused SiLU and width-4 specialization. Reference for CTOX's persistent FP16-history Qwen causal-convolution candidate.
Unmodified public host declaration paired with ssm-conv.cu.

required_includes_not_vendored.reason: Framework glue (device props, stream helpers, ggml_cuda_dp4a at line 694). Pulls in the full ggml API headers; outside the minimum kernel-reference set. Must be re-added before any real compilation of the vendored files.
ggml core public API; framework scope, not a 2-bit/4-bit kernel reference.
ggml internal helpers required by common.cuh; framework scope.
ggml CUDA backend public header required by common.cuh; framework scope.
CUDA toolkit include shim selected by common.cuh on NVIDIA builds; toolchain scope.
Required by mmq.cu host dispatch for activation quantization; not part of the 2-bit/4-bit weight-path reference.
Required by mmq.cu for MoE expert routing; out of scope for the dense fused matvec baseline.
Required by the unmodified ssm-conv.cu only for ggml's generic SiLU helper. The CTOX adaptation provides its model-specific fused activation directly and does not compile framework glue.

notes: The vendored files are reference material for correctness baselines only and are not compiled into the crate. CTOX model-format candidates must remain separate, retain ref anchors, and pass same-device verifier and benchmark gates.

Upstream layouts (Q2_K/Q4_K super-blocks) differ from the crate Q2_B64/Q4_B64 layouts (64-value blocks, f16 scale, no zero-point); the vendored files pin the dp4a/mma techniques and launch geometry, not the block format.
Q3 formats exist upstream but are deliberately out of scope; this crate supports only Q2_B64 and Q4_B64.
Promotion to Verifier requires the same-device evidence described in docs/CUDA_KERNEL_NOTES.md and docs/PROMOTION_GATES.md.
